title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (AWS, PySpark, Airflow)


Employment Type: independant contractor

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Business Model & Pricing (BMP) Analytics team. In this role, you will design and build scalable data systems that power analytics, reporting, and AI/ML initiatives across the organization.

You will work closely with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure reliable, high-quality data is available to drive strategic decisions.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines using SQL, Python, and PySpark
  • Develop and optimize data models and data warehouse solutions (Snowflake, data lake)
  • Implement and manage workflow orchestration using Airflow
  • Build and support data infrastructure on AWS
  • Ensure data quality, governance, and reliability across systems
  • Collaborate with analytics and business teams to deliver data-driven solutions
  • Support AI/ML initiatives by enabling data pipelines and MLOps workflows
  • Contribute to data products and applications (e.g., Streamlit dashboards, chatbot integrations)
  • Drive best practices in data engineering, automation, and performance optimization

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering or Data Platform development
  • Strong hands-on experience with SQL and Python
  • Experience with PySpark / Spark (big data processing)
  • Hands-on experience with Airflow or similar orchestration tools
  • Strong experience with AWS (S3, Glue, EMR, Redshift, etc.)
  • Experience with data warehousing (Snowflake or similar)
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT, and data architecture
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with data lake architectures and hybrid environments
  • Exposure to MLOps and machine learning pipelines
  • Experience with Streamlit or data applications
  • Familiarity with chatbots or conversational data interfaces
  • Experience working in global or matrix organizations
  • Contributions to documentation platforms (Confluence, etc.)

title: Video Editor - Remote (Short-Form Ads)
description:
Video Editor & Graphic Designer


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.


What You'll Do

Video Editing & Production

  • Create high-performing Facebook/Instagram ad creatives and social media clips
  • Edit short-form content optimized for platform-specific formats
  • Source and organize B-roll and stock footage using the provided subscriptions
  • Manage creator content in Frame.io and maintain organized asset libraries

Graphic Design & Assets

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics
  • Create on-brand visual assets using Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Project Management

  • Track assignments and status updates in ClickUp
  • Follow naming conventions and file organization protocols
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Job Title: Business Development Representative

Company: DolFinContent LLC

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full Time (Contractor)


About DolFinContent

DolFinContent LLC is a talent agency specializing in influencers, representing digital creators worldwide and connecting them with brands through strategic partnerships, sponsorships, and campaign opportunities. The agency focuses on long-term creator growth, brand alignment, and professional representation within the creator economy.


Position Overview

DolFinContent is seeking a Business Development Representative to support the continued expansion of the agency’s influencer roster. This role focuses on identifying high-potential creators, conducting professional outreach, managing onboarding, and supporting talent relationship development. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and passionate about social media, creator partnerships, and talent development.


Key Responsibilities

• Identify, source, and recruit influencers and digital creators across major social media platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Twitch, Kick, and emerging platforms

• Conduct professional outreach through social media platforms, email communication, and networking tools

• Manage the onboarding process for new creators, including agreements, internal documentation, and profile setup

• Build and maintain strong professional relationships with creators through consistent communication

• Maintain accurate internal databases, including talent rosters, creator profiles, and recruitment pipelines

• Research social media trends and identify emerging creators with strong growth potential

• Support general talent operations and recruitment initiatives as needed

• Native or fluent English proficiency (written and verbal) is required

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities

• Interest in influencer marketing, talent management, recruiting, or digital media

• Experience with Google Sheets, Excel, CRM systems, or outreach tools is preferred

• Previous experience in recruiting, talent sourcing, or influencer marketing is a plus

• Base compensation of 1,000 USD per month

• Commission opportunities based on creators successfully recruited and onboarded

• Performance-based earning potential with growth opportunities

• Professional development within talent acquisition and creator partnerships

• Remote work environment

• Performance-based growth opportunities

If you are passionate about social media, talent discovery, and relationship building, we encourage you to apply and join DolFinContent’s growing global team.

title: Trilingual Junior Administrative Assistant (English, Spanish, Portuguese)
description:
A US-based law firm is looking for a proactive and detail-oriented trilingual Junior Administrative Assistant to join our team remotely as a contractor (third-party service provider).


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Intake, sales skills, and customer service skills.
  • Strong analytical skills with great attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • Excellent organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • A collaborative, teamwork-oriented mindset with a strong sense of empathy.

  • Reliable home office setup, including appropriate hardware, software, and high-speed internet.

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
ITTConnect is seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for supporting and maintaining customer IT infrastructure within the Managed Services environment. This role focuses on resolving technical issues, supporting backend infrastructure systems, and collaborating with customer IT teams to deploy and maintain solutions. Infrastructure Engineers combine technical troubleshooting with proactive monitoring and documentation to ensure stable and secure client environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to servers, virtualization, storage, and core infrastructure systems.
  • Serve as an escalation point for the IT Support team on complex infrastructure-related incidents.
  • Work directly with customers and their IT teams to support the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of infrastructure solutions.
  • Investigate alerts and system reports to proactively identify potential infrastructure issues and performance risks.
  • Follow established runbooks, procedures, and architectural documentation to resolve incidents.
  • Exercise sound technical judgment when diagnosing and resolving infrastructure issues that may not have predefined solutions.
  • Assist with the creation and maintenance of runbooks, diagrams, and infrastructure documentation.
  • Participate in system maintenance activities such as upgrades, patching, and system health checks.
  • Document incident resolution steps and system changes within internal ticketing and knowledge management systems.
  • Maintain strong communication with internal teams and customers regarding issue status and resolution timelines.



Requirements

  • 8+ years of IT experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • 3–6 years of experience supporting IT infrastructure in an MSP, enterprise IT, or hosting environment.
  • Experience with Windows or Linux server administration.
  • Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.).
  • Familiarity with storage, backup, and disaster recovery systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Experience working within ticketing systems and following structured support processes.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD).
  • Cloud platform administration experience; Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) are preferred.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including infrastructure design, administration, and troubleshooting.
  • Administration experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), and enterprise storage platforms.
  • Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
ITTConnect is seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for supporting and maintaining customer IT infrastructure within the Managed Services environment. This role focuses on resolving technical issues, supporting backend infrastructure systems, and collaborating with customer IT teams to deploy and maintain solutions. Infrastructure Engineers combine technical troubleshooting with proactive monitoring and documentation to ensure stable and secure client environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to servers, virtualization, storage, and core infrastructure systems.
  • Serve as an escalation point for the IT Support team on complex infrastructure-related incidents.

  • Investigate alerts and system reports to proactively identify potential infrastructure issues and performance risks.
  • Follow established runbooks, procedures, and architectural documentation to resolve incidents.

  • Assist with the creation and maintenance of runbooks, diagrams, and infrastructure documentation.
  • Participate in system maintenance activities such as upgrades, patching, and system health checks.
  • Document incident resolution steps and system changes within internal ticketing and knowledge management systems.

title: Account Executive
description:
Job Description


Full Time

Remote: Latin America

Rate: 4.000 USD


About Company

Company is a global brand protection platform that helps companies detect and remove counterfeit products across marketplaces, social media, and search engines.

Our technology identifies infringing listings, collects legally valid evidence, and coordinates takedowns at scale — protecting brands, consumers, and intellectual property online.

Counterfeiting is a $500B+ global problem, and companies are increasingly investing in solutions that protect their brand reputation, revenue, and customers.

We work with companies that need real protection against digital counterfeiting, and our sales team plays a critical role in helping organizations understand the scale of the problem and the value of solving it.


The Role

We’re looking for a high-performing Account Executive who is obsessed with closing deals.

At Company , this role is not about managing accounts. This role is about turning qualified pipeline into revenue.


What You’ll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle from Discovery to Close
  • Lead discovery calls and qualify opportunities
  • Identify and map the full buying committee within target organizations
  • Deliver tailored product demos to stakeholders
  • Build business cases around brand protection, legal risk, and revenue protection
  • Negotiate commercial terms and contracts
  • Manage pipeline inside the CRM and maintain deal momentum
  • Work closely with internal teams to ensure successful deal execution
  • Consistently meet or exceed quarterly revenue targets


Requirements (Non-negotiable)

  • Fluent spoken and written Spanish & English
  • 3–6+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales
  • Proven experience closing $20K+ contracts
  • Strong discovery and qualification skills
  • Experience managing multi-stakeholder buying processes
  • Comfortable presenting and negotiating with senior decision-makers
  • Highly organized pipeline management
  • Strong ownership of revenue outcomes


Strong Pluses

  • Experience selling LegalTech, Compliance, Risk, or Brand Protection solutions
  • Experience selling to legal teams, brand protection teams, or compliance departments
  • Experience selling to U.S. companies
  • Previous experience in early-stage startups
  • Experience managing enterprise sales cycles


This Role is NOT for You If

  • You expect inbound leads to do the work
  • You are uncomfortable leading discovery conversations
  • You struggle navigating complex buying processes
  • You prefer account management over closing deals
  • You are not motivated by revenue targets


This Role IS for You If

  • You consider yourself elite at closing deals
  • You enjoy selling complex solutions to senior stakeholders
  • You thrive in high-performance environments
  • You are motivated by commission and performance
  • You want to build a strong enterprise sales career in SaaS

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Now Hiring | PS Project Coordinator

Location: Remote (LATAM – Brazil / Colombia)

Duration: 12+ Months

Rate: $13 USD/hour


About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Project Coordinator to support Professional Services (PS) project delivery in a fast-paced, global environment.

This role will focus on project coordination, scheduling, communication, and reporting , ensuring smooth execution from kickoff through completion.


Required Skills

  • Fluent in Spanish and English (Portuguese is a plus).
  • Strong communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation).
  • Excellent organizational and time management abilities .
  • Experience with:
  • Spreadsheets and project management tools
  • Task tracking and prioritization
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and timelines .
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy .
  • Experience with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive) .
  • Background supporting technical or IT-related projects .

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business , or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2–3 years of experience in Project Coordination or Project Management .


If you’re highly organized, proactive, and enjoy keeping projects on track, this is a great opportunity to grow your career in project coordination

title: Analista de Governança de Dados Sênior
description:
Você acredita que dados de qualidade são o alicerce para uma IA de sucesso? Sabe que governança não é burocracia, mas sim eficiência e confiança?


Na redspark , estamos em busca de um perfil sênior para transformar nossos instrumentos de governança em ferramentas vivas. Sua missão será garantir a integridade, a padronização e a rastreabilidade das informações que alimentam nossas maiores inovações.


Seu papel no time:

  • Operacionalizar o Catálogo e Metadados: Implementar e gerir o catálogo para que datasets críticos sejam facilmente encontrados e compreendidos.
  • Gestão do Glossário: Ser a ponte que padroniza os termos de negócio entre diferentes sistemas.
  • Data Quality na veia: Implementar regras de qualidade, monitorar métricas e apoiar o tratamento de inconsistências.
  • Mestria em Dados (MDM): Apoiar a estruturação de fontes autoritativas e dados mestres.
  • Linhagem e Transparência: Garantir a documentação e a rastreabilidade total da informação (da origem ao consumo).
  • Guardião da Padronização: Auxiliar na organização de datasets prontos para Analytics e IA.

title: Chief Revenue Officer
description:
Chief Revenue Officer


The Opportunity


We're looking for a seasoned Chief Revenue Officer to help our client — an AI-powered logistics SaaS company — build and scale their US enterprise revenue engine from the ground up.


Our client is a Houston-based, seed-funded logistics platform founded in 2019. They bring consumer-app simplicity to enterprise logistics, unifying appointment scheduling, dock and yard management, and gate digitization for shippers, 3PLs, and carriers.


They've built real product-market traction and are now ready to scale. That's where you come in.


The Role


Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll own the entire US enterprise revenue motion end-to-end — strategy, hiring, pipeline, forecasting, and expansion. This is a rare \"own the whole thing\" seat: you'll set GTM strategy, build the team, and personally drive early pipeline until that team is in place.


What You'll Do


  • Build and execute the US enterprise GTM strategy from scratch
  • Hire, onboard, and lead the full revenue organization — AEs, BDRs, and sales management
  • Personally carry and close strategic early enterprise deals while the team ramps
  • Own pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue operations
  • Partner with the CEO on pricing, packaging, and market positioning
  • Establish the sales culture, process, and playbook for a company scaling from near-zero to multi-million in ARR



What We're Looking For


Required:


  • 15–20 years of revenue leadership experience at the CRO level
  • Demonstrated track record scaling revenue from near-zero to multi-million within US enterprise
  • Proven experience hiring, building, and leading revenue teams (AEs, BDRs, sales managers) — not a solo operator with a CRO title
  • Deep logistics or supply chain industry experience
  • Native-level English and executive-level presence
  • Willingness to provide 2–3 references from prior employers


You'll thrive in this role if you:


  • Have reference-able revenue numbers you can point to from prior companies
  • Are energized by building from scratch rather than managing a mature org
  • Can toggle fluidly between strategy, recruiting, and rolling up your sleeves to close deals
  • Have operated inside or sold into US enterprise logistics, freight, or supply chain


This is not the right fit if you:

  • Come from a mid-market or non-logistics SaaS background
  • Have primarily tactical experience (AE, sales manager) without true org leadership
  • Lead with CRM/pipeline theater rather than produced revenue
  • Have never built or managed a revenue team

description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer – GCP & Snowflake (BigQuery, Python, Airflow)

Location: Mexico/ Brazil / Costa Rica (Remote)

Type: Contract / FTE


Summary:

Looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong experience in BigQuery, Snowflake, Python, and Airflow/Composer to support, stabilize, and scale data pipelines. The role includes managing Snowflake workflows, operating migrated BigQuery pipelines, and integrating international logic into global data platforms for scalability and standardization across AWS, GCP, and Snowflake environments.


Key Skills:

BigQuery, Snowflake, Python, SQL, Airflow/Composer, ETL/ELT, GitHub, CI/CD, Data Warehousing (Star Schema, Dimensional Modeling, OLTP vs OLAP)


Responsibilities:

Support existing Snowflake workflows; Operate and stabilize BigQuery pipelines; Integrate international/Paramount logic into global pipelines; Design and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines across AWS, GCP, Snowflake; Implement data quality checks and reconciliation; Optimize performance and cost (BigQuery/Snowflake); Manage workflows and CI/CD; Maintain documentation


Experience:

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field; 12–15 years overall IT experience; 7–9 years in data engineering


Nice to Have:

Adobe Analytics; Experience with global data standardization; Strong DevOps practices

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Solutions Architect – Sao Paulo / Hybrid - Fluent French & English

(Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, Software Implementation, Solutions Architecture, SaaS, Architecture, API Integrations, REST, Web Services, CRM, eCommerce, ERP, OMS, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant)


Our client is an exciting and cutting-edge fintech giant with a global presence. They have been a market leader within the fintech consultancy sector for many years and their worldwide client base has never been stronger, with significant growth in the last 12 months. They are looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to own the end-to-end solution design, implement their cloud-based space planning and design platforms and ensure solution integrity from discovery through deployment.


As an experienced Solutions Architect, you will be responsible for providing architectural oversight across multiple concurrent implementations and leading architectural discovery sessions with customer stakeholders. This will include designing end-to-end solution architectures across SaaS platforms, APIs, middleware, CRM, eCommerce, and Order Management systems.


Expert knowledge of cloud-based SaaS architecture and API integrations, such as REST and Web Services is essential, as experience leading enterprise-level software implementations. Experience working in multi-system ecosystems, such as CRM, eCommerce, ERP and OMS is also expected. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills are a must, as you will be acting as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers and presenting solution designs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You will also need to have excellent time and priority management skills that enable you to work in different time zones and speak and write fluently in French and English.


We are keen to hear from talented Solutions Architect candidates from all backgrounds.


This is a truly amazing opportunity to work for a prestigious brand that will do wonders for your career. They invest heavily in training and career development; top performers are guaranteed a career path into senior and lead positions within 12 months.


Location: Sao Paulo / Hybrid

Salary: 160k BRL – 190k BRL + Bonus + Pension + Excellent Benefits

Languages: Fluent in French and English


To apply for this position please send your CV to Karan Gajjar at Noir Consulting.

As an experienced Solutions Architect, you will be responsible for providing architectural oversight across multiple concurrent implementations and leading architectural discovery sessions with customer stakeholders. This will include designing end-to-end solution architectures across SaaS platforms, APIs, middleware, CRM, eCommerce, and Order Management systems.


Expert knowledge of cloud-based SaaS architecture and API integrations, such as REST and Web Services is essential, as experience leading enterprise-level software implementations. Experience working in multi-system ecosystems, such as CRM, eCommerce, ERP and OMS is also expected. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills are a must, as you will be acting as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers and presenting solution designs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You will also need to have excellent time and priority management skills that enable you to work in different time zones and speak and write fluently in French and English.


We are keen to hear from talented Solutions Architect candidates from all backgrounds.


This is a truly amazing opportunity to work for a prestigious brand that will do wonders for your career. They invest heavily in training and career development; top performers are guaranteed a career path into senior and lead positions within 12 months.

Salary: 160k BRL – 190k BRL + Bonus + Pension + Excellent Benefits

Languages: Fluent in French and English


To apply for this position please send your CV to Karan Gajjar at Noir Consulting.

title: DevOps - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: DevOps - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação em projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

Obrigatório

  • Conhecimentos básicos em Linux (terminal, análise de logs e processos)
  • Lógica de programação e/ou scripting (Python, Bash ou similar)
  • Noções de Git (clone, commit, pull request)
  • Conceitos iniciais de automação e infraestrutura como código
  • Conhecimento conceitual sobre containers e Kubernetes/OpenShift
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de arquivos YAML





O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Demmand Planing Specialist
description:
RESPONSIBILITIES - WITH OUR CONSUMER AT THE HEART YOUR KEY

FOCUS WILL BE

• Responsible for sell out and sell in forecast construction and alignment with the distributors (or

marketing and sales team for direct markets) in the markets under your scope.

• You will receive, consolidate and analyse the sales and inventory actuals and forecast from

distributors (or customers for direct markets) and you will lead a Demand Review with your

customers and / or Bacardi commercial teams to align on sell out forecast and sell in plan.

• You will build an S&OP forecast that will be the input for the IBP cycle and you will present

valuable insights for business alignment identifying gaps and opportunities in your markets.

• Responsible for making your sales plan happen, anticipating risks and challenges and serving as

a bridge between the markets under your scope and the rest of Bacardí Supply Chain functions, to

make sure that your demand plan and your customers PO’s are met.

• Responsible for Demand management in Bacardí System. Ensuring that demand is reflected in

the correct codes to the right product origins with anticipation and accuracy. You will collaborate

with plants and innovation teams to ensure that all the innovations are correctly forecasted in the

time and quantities that the business requires.

• You will manage the product life cycle process, ensuring that the changes, innovations, delistings,

etc are correctly reflected in the system and planned with anticipation.

• Deliver continuously improve forecasting techniques, method, and approach to make a step

change on forecast accuracy.

• Provide visibility of KPIs: BIAS, Accuracy, Orders delayed and be a support in action plans to

improve them.

• Support the cross functional team of Sales, Marketing, Operations and Finance to achieve

consensus each month within the S&OP cycle.

• Provide visibility for Slow & No Movers, and agree actions plans to mitigate obsolescence and

write off.

SKILLS - THE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE NEEDED TO CREATE YOUR LEGACY

• 3 years of experience in demand planning roles.

• Advanced Excel required, BI and SAP desirable.

• Outstanding analytical skills and attention to detail.

• Fluent in Spanish and Portuguese written and spoken, both used in your day to day communication and work. Business English required for communication with global functions and plants.

• Business savvy and a good understanding of the consumer & customer needs. Ability and willingness to learn and interact with other functions and customers.

• Ability to find effective ways of working within a matrix organization, and within a fast-changing

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
A Terracotta Investimentos é um escritório credenciado à XP, com sede em Franca/SP. Nosso propósito é claro: ajudar cada vez mais pessoas a investir melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de assessores qualificados, apaixonados pelo que fazem — e agora, queremos crescer ainda mais.

Estamos expandindo nossas operações e abrindo novas oportunidades para Assessores de Investimentos em Ribeirão Preto .

O que buscamos :

Gente com vontade de fazer acontecer. Se você tem visão de dono, disciplina, e quer construir sua própria carteira de clientes com liberdade e responsabilidade, aqui pode ser o seu lugar.

Pré-requisitos :

  • Perfil autônomo, com garra, foco em resultados e brilho nos olhos;
  • Excelente comunicação (oral e escrita) e facilidade de relacionamento;
  • Certificação ANCORD.

Atividades do dia a dia:

  • Prospecção e captação de novos clientes e recursos;
  • Construção e manutenção de relacionamento de longo prazo com sua base;
  • Elaboração de portfólios alinhados ao perfil de cada investidor;
  • Análise de carteiras externas, comparativos e sugestões personalizadas;
  • Acompanhamento constante do mercado e cenário econômico.

Diferenciais :

  • Experiência anterior no mercado financeiro, especialmente em bancos ou corretoras;
  • Certificações CEA, CFP, CGA ou CFA;
  • Pós-graduação em investimentos ou áreas correlatas.

O que oferecemos :

  • Ambiente colaborativo e meritocrático;
  • Liberdade com responsabilidade para crescer como autônomo;
  • Remuneração variável com potencial agressivo;
  • Programa de partnership para quem sonha em ser sócio no futuro;
  • Suporte estratégico para desenvolvimento comercial e técnico.

Se você acredita no seu potencial e quer crescer em um time que joga junto, vem conversar com a gente. Aqui, seu sucesso é o nosso crescimento também.

Se identificou? Se inscreva e vamos tomar um café!

title: Analista de Business Intelligence PL
description:
Analista de Business Intelligence PL

Modelo híbrido (3x presencial | 2x home office)

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em uma área estratégica, com forte impacto na tomada de decisão e na performance comercial.

description:

title: FilmMaker - PRESENCIAL
description:
Vaga: Filmmaker / Videomaker – DWV

A DWV está buscando um Filmmaker criativo e ágil para produzir conteúdos que impactam o mercado imobiliário brasileiro.

Se você gosta de captar boas histórias, editar com ritmo e transformar ideias em vídeos que prendem atenção, essa vaga é para você.

O que você vai fazer:

Filmagem de podcasts e entrevistas (principalmente do podcast Segredos Imobiliários).

Produção de vídeos para redes sociais (Instagram, YouTube e outros formatos digitais).

Edição de vídeos para conteúdo longo e cortes curtos.

Tratamento básico de cor, áudio e finalização.

Apoiar na criação visual e narrativa dos conteúdos da DWV.

O que esperamos de você

title: IT Site Support Manager
description:
Overview

The IT Site Support Manager is responsible for leading and developing the IT Site Support Team, delivering a high-quality end-user experience, and ensuring the effective application of ITIL best practices. This role plays a critical part in standardizing IT support operations, optimizing costs, and ensuring compliance with corporate IT and security standards.

The manager will collaborate closely with global IT teams, vendors, and business stakeholders, supporting enterprise initiatives and ensuring consistent, efficient, and secure IT support services across the site.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance Management

  • Lead, coach, and manage the IT Site Support team to ensure individual and team performance expectations are consistently met.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and support skills development and career growth.
  • Ensure adequate staffing, workload distribution, and coverage to meet business needs.

End-User Experience & Service Delivery

  • Drive continuous improvement of the end-user IT support experience.
  • Measure service satisfaction levels, analyze feedback, and implement improvement actions.
  • Manage and uphold the incident troubleshooting and escalation process to ensure timely and effective resolution.

ITIL, Process & Operational Excellence

  • Apply ITIL best practices across incident, problem, and service request management.
  • Identify gaps in IT support processes and implement enhancements to improve efficiency and service quality.
  • Work closely with the Service Desk team to ensure proper documentation, knowledge sharing, and user guidance related to incidents and requests.
  • Ensure all IT support activities are properly documented and records are maintained accurately.

Standardization, Cost & Vendor Management

  • Identify opportunities for standardization, operational efficiency, and cost reduction.
  • Develop and implement strategies to achieve measurable cost savings.
  • Review reports related to hardware, peripherals, malfunctions, maintenance, and productivity impact to address recurring issues.
  • Negotiate and manage contracts with vendors, consultants, and technical service providers.

Technology Implementation & Global Collaboration

  • Assist global IT teams with the remediation and implementation of new technologies, systems, and devices.
  • Support the adoption and enforcement of corporate standards for hardware, software, applications, and IT security.
  • Collaborate with regional and global IT stakeholders to align local support activities with enterprise initiatives.

Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure all IT support activities comply with company policies, procedures, and security guidelines.
  • Support audits, reporting, and management reviews as required.

Qualifications & Experience

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in IT support management or a similar leadership role.
  • Strong working knowledge of ITIL best practices .
  • Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory , as this role regularly interacts with global teams, stakeholders, and vendors .
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven leadership and people management capabilities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience planning and executing cost-reduction and process improvement initiatives.
  • Solid knowledge of corporate IT standards related to hardware, applications, and IT security.
  • Ability to independently manage responsibilities while effectively collaborating with global teams.

Nice to Have

  • Additional language skills , such as Spanish or Portuguese , are a plus and beneficial for collaboration with regional teams and local stakeholders.
  • ITIL certification or other relevant IT service management certifications.
  • Experience supporting multi-site or regional IT operations.

title: Consultor de Hidráulica (Industrial Celulose)
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Desafio:

Atuar como referência técnica e consultiva em nossos sistemas hidráulicos industriais, garantindo a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e eficiência dos equipamentos utilizados no processo produtivo. Prover suporte avançado para equipes de manutenção, engenharia de confiabilidade e operação, orientando diagnósticos, melhorias e a implementação de soluções hidráulicas de alta robustez.

Atividades Principais:

  • Gerenciar a equipe de técnicos de manutenção hidráulica, assegurando que a equipe seja treinada e qualificada para realizar manutenções complexas, utilizando ferramentas e técnicas adequadas, assim como, distribuindo tarefas de acordo com as prioridades de manutenção, garantindo que os recursos sejam alocados de forma eficiente e assegurando que os colaboradores sigam normas e regulamentos de segurança, como o uso de EPI (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual);
  • Realizar diagnósticos e manutenções detalhadas e troubleshooting em sistemas hidráulicos presentes nas principais áreas operacionais da planta;
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho de equipamentos hidráulicos de alta criticidade;
  • Gerir o time nas atividades de reparo durante as paradas, assegurando que todas as equipes estejam sincronizadas e que os materiais e peças de reposição estejam disponíveis, monitorando o cumprimento dos cronogramas e tomando medidas corretivas em caso de atrasos ou desvios no planejamento;
  • Desenvolver e revisar planos de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e inspeções aplicados às rotinas da planta;
  • Elaborar pareceres técnicos, instruções de trabalho, procedimentos e padrões de montagem/ajuste específicos para a unidade;
  • Documentar detalhadamente os estudos de falhas, as lições aprendidas e as soluções implementadas, criando um banco de dados de conhecimento que sirva de referência para futuras análises e treinamentos, garantindo que o aprendizado seja capitalizado pela organização;
  • Pesquisar e analisar a viabilidade de implementação de novas tecnologias e metodologias aplicados nas reformas de manutenção em oficina que possam aumentar a confiabilidade e a eficiência dos equipamentos;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Suprimentos e Engenharia de Confiabilidade para avaliar o desempenho de componentes críticos e propor a padronização ou substituição por outros de maior durabilidade e confiabilidade, baseando-se em análises técnicas e de custo-benefício;
  • Desenvolver e ministrar programas de treinamento e workshops para o time de manutenção hidráulica, elevando o nível técnico e a capacidade de diagnóstico;
  • Realizar pesquisas de benchmarking com outras empresas ou indústrias de equivalente para identificar as melhores práticas em manutenção mecânica e propor a sua adaptação e implementação na fábrica;
  • Colaborar com a Engenharia de Confiabilidade na análise do ciclo de vida de equipamentos, fornecendo insights técnicos sobre a viabilidade de reformas vs. substituições, considerando custos de manutenção acumulados, criticidade e tecnologias disponíveis;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o Almoxarifado e Suprimentos para otimizar o estoque de sobressalentes de componentes hidráulicos, garantindo a disponibilidade de itens críticos sem incorrer em custos excessivos de capital parado;
  • Auxiliar na gestão dos custos da função Hidráulica, realizando a previsão do orçamento anual de (Spend e Headcount), incluindo custos de peças, mão de obra e outros recursos, assim como, acompanhar mensalmente os custos realizados, alocando corretamente nas contas contábeis, apresentando e validando com o gestor imediato durante as reuniões de análise crítica, visando o cumprimento do orçamento e otimização dos custos;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com o time de engenharia, produção e segurança, apoiando e executando projetos de melhorias, inovação, modificações e modernização de instalações, máquinas e equipamentos, normas e planos de manutenção, identificando causa raiz, apresentando soluções corretivas e preventivas, evitando recorrências, otimizando custos e aumentando a disponibilidade das máquinas e equipamentos;
  • Treinar e orientar tecnicamente os times de manutenção, nos procedimentos e melhores práticas, promovendo a melhoria contínua das habilidades e conhecimento, bem como, assegurando que o time esteja treinado e capacitado para assumir as atividades de manutenção após o startup da planta, disponibilizando ferramentas, recursos técnicos e humanos para apoiar os fornecedores dos equipamentos e tecnologias;
  • Elaborar escopos de contratação de serviços terceirizados de manutenção, participando ativamente das etapas de negociação e avaliação técnica, assegurando as melhores práticas, custos adequados, qualidade, segurança e a confiabilidade em todo o processo;
  • Participar ativamente do processo de planejamento e execução da Parada Geral da planta, realizando o mapeamento das atividades de manutenção, através de alinhamento com a gerência de produção, mitigando os riscos e impactos gerados, desenvolvendo estratégias e plano de ação, avaliando e desenvolvendo fornecedores e prestadores de serviço, sempre prezando pela segurança e otimização dos custos;
  • Implantar, monitorar e analisar diariamente os indicadores de desempenho da sua área de atuação (Custos, disponibilidade, produtividade, estoque de peças de reposição etc.), viabilizando ajustes no planejamento, procedimentos e nos processos;
  • Cumprir, fazer cumprir e promover os padrões de segurança e regulamentações aplicadas às pessoas e aos equipamentos, através da realização de avaliação de riscos e implantação de medidas, alinhas à gestão;
  • Zelar pela organização e limpeza das áreas de atuação utilizando ferramentas como 5S garantindo que todo o processo seja implementado, conhecido e aplicado pelo time de manutenção;
  • Garantir que as atividades de manutenção estejam alinhadas aos objetivos e requisitos da área cliente, através de alinhamento e interação com a área demandante, para entendimento da necessidade e expectativa de prazos e qualidade da entrega;
  • Outras atividades correlatas;

Requisitos

  • Curso superior completo em Engenharias e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Especialização em Manutenção Industrial, Gestão de Projetos, Lean Manufacturing e afins será um diferencial;
  • Domínio de técnicas e ferramentas de análise de falhas (Root Cause Analysis - RCA, 5 Porquês, Diagrama de Ishikawa), com capacidade de identificar causas-raiz e propor soluções eficazes;
  • Técnicas de manutenção preditiva (análise de vibração, termografia, ultrassom, análise de óleo) e planejamento de manutenção preventiva;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas hidráulicos Bosch Rexroth (Hägglunds).

title: Senior Payments Manager - Brazil
description:
Brazil's payment landscape is complex, fast-moving, and full of opportunity and Antom is building the infrastructure to lead it. We're looking for a Senior Payments Manager who thrives at the intersection of relationship management and operational excellence: someone who can navigate Brazil's financial ecosystem with depth and turn strong partnerships into real payment performance.

What you'll do:

Financial institution & payment partner management

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for Antom's local payment partners in Brazil, including PIX providers, card acquirers, and Open Finance participants.
  • Maintain and deepen these partnerships to ensure reliability, competitive terms, and long-term strategic alignment.

Payment performance & operations

  • In close collaboration with Antom's internal operations team, monitor and improve SLAs, success rates, and KPIs across local payment methods.
  • Identify performance gaps, coordinate resolution efforts with partners, and drive continuous improvement in payment reliability and conversion.

New payment method onboarding

  • Scout, evaluate, and onboard new local payment methods and financial institution partners that expand Antom's capabilities in Brazil.
  • Lead the end-to-end process from commercial negotiation through to technical go-live.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Act as Antom's internal Brazil payments subject-matter expert, aligning with Product, Tech, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure local solutions are properly integrated and optimized.

Regulatory awareness

  • Stay ahead of Banco Central regulations, PIX rulebook updates, Open Finance developments, and card scheme rules.
  • Translate regulatory changes into actionable internal recommendations and partner discussions.

Market intelligence

  • Continuously map the Brazilian payments landscape — tracking competitor capabilities, emerging payment trends, and new fintech entrants to inform Antom's local strategy.

What we're looking for

  • 5–8 years in payments, financial institutions partnerships, or payment operations within a fintech, bank, acquirer, payment processor, or global payments company — with a strong focus on the Brazilian market.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of Brazil's payment ecosystem: PIX, card acquiring, and Open Finance, including its regulatory framework and key institutional players.
  • Proven relationship management skills — ability to build and manage senior-level relationships with banks, acquirers, and payment institutions, including navigating complex contractual and operational discussions.
  • Operational mindset — comfortable owning KPIs and SLAs, troubleshooting payment issues with technical and partner teams, and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Cross-functional communication — able to work across commercial, product, tech, and compliance teams, translating between business needs and technical requirements with ease.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese and full professional English proficiency.

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience at a global payments company, international acquirer, or cross-border payment platform operating in Brazil.
  • Existing network across Brazilian financial institutions, acquirers, and Open Finance participants.
  • Familiarity with API-based payment integrations and the technical fundamentals of payment processing.
  • A practical approach to AI tools — using them to automate routine tasks, accelerate analysis, and improve the quality and efficiency of your own work output.
  • MBA or advanced degree in Business, Finance, or a related field.
  • Mandarin is a strong plus.

About Antom

Antom is a leading merchant payment and digitisation services provider under Ant International. We help global merchants and partners accept digital payments, scale their businesses across borders, and deliver seamless checkout experiences to consumers worldwide. In Brazil, we are investing in the local payments ecosystem to become the infrastructure layer of choice for merchants operating in or into the market.

title: Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - Truck Center - Inovação em Sistemas
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A Truck Center é uma empresa paranaense com mais de 35 anos de atuação no desenvolvimento de equipamentos e softwares automotivos para alinhamento, balanceamento e serviços de pneus em veículos leves e pesados. Com forte foco em tecnologia, precisão e melhoria contínua, a empresa se destaca pelo compromisso com inovação e qualidade, oferecendo soluções completas que incluem fabricação, treinamento e suporte técnico. Diante disso, a Truck Center busca avançar em novos desafios, especialmente na criação de sistemas mais modernos e integrados para alinhamento, balanceamento e calibração automotiva.

Projeto: Inovação em sistemas de alinhamento, balanceamento e calibração automotiva.

Doutorado completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia de Produção, Mecatrônica, Eletrônica, Física ou áreas correlatas.

  • Conhecimentos sobre under car, tanto da linha leve como da linha pesada, sistemas de alinhamento e geometria de veículos e balanceamento de rodas.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description:
Note: This role is 100% remote, but we require overlap with Eastern Time (EST/EDT) working hours to ensure smooth collaboration with the team.

Company Introduction

NextDay AI is a privately held company specializing in applying artificial intelligence (AI) engineering and creative innovation in B2C entertainment products. Our mission is to leverage the power of Large Language Models (LLM) and generative AI (Gen AI) to create innovative consumer products that push the boundaries of entertainment and companionship. With over 35 millions+ messages per day and millions of monthly visitors, our products are revolutionizing the way people interact with AI.

This is a unique opportunity to participate and make a real difference in a company actively working to shape the future of AI applications for consumers.

Job Description

We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who can own and drive the frontend experience across our web and mobile products. We need someone who sees problems, proposes solutions, and ships them. You’ll be working across a modern React (web) and React Native (mobile) codebase, building features used by millions of users every day.

You’ll care deeply about code quality, maintainability, and performance - and you’ll champion the use of AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to move faster without sacrificing standards. You’re the kind of engineer who treats AI coding assistants as a force multiplier, not a crutch, and you’re always looking for ways to improve code quality and performance with these tools.

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role. You’ll collaborate closely with product, design, backend engineers, and QA - but at the end of the day, you’ll own your domain and be trusted to make the right calls.

What You’ll Do

  • Build, ship, and maintain high-quality features across our React web application and React Native mobile app, working across the full frontend surface area.
  • Take ownership of major frontend initiatives end-to-end - from technical design through implementation, testing, and deployment - without needing hand-holding.
  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable TypeScript code that other engineers can confidently build on. Champion code quality standards, review PRs thoroughly, and help to raise the bar for the whole team.
  • Actively leverage AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) and agentic workflows to accelerate development. Advocate for and help the team adopt best practices around AI-augmented engineering.
  • Collaborate with Product, Design, and QA to translate requirements into elegant, performant user experiences. Push back when something doesn’t make sense and propose better alternatives.
  • Improve our frontend architecture, patterns, and tooling. Identify technical debt and address it proactively - you don’t wait for permission to make things better.
  • Contribute to our shared business logic and component libraries, ensuring consistency across web and mobile platforms.
  • Mentor and support other engineers through code reviews, pairing sessions, and knowledge sharing. Lead by example.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional frontend engineering experience with a strong track record of shipping production software at scale.
  • Deep expertise in React and the modern React ecosystem (hooks, context, routing, state management). You don’t just use React - you understand it.
  • Solid experience with React Native or strong willingness to ramp up quickly. We need someone comfortable building across both web and mobile.
  • Advanced TypeScript proficiency. You write typed code by default and understand how to use the type system to prevent bugs and improve developer experience.
  • A genuine passion for clean, maintainable code. You care about naming things well, keeping components focused, writing meaningful tests, and leaving code better than you found it.
  • Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted development tools and a clear point of view on how to use them effectively. You’re a champion of agentic coding workflows and can show how you’ve used them to ship faster.
  • Self-directed and proactive. You take initiative, own your work fully, and don’t need to be managed closely. You see what needs doing and do it.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. You can articulate technical decisions clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, startup-like environment where priorities shift and ambiguity is the norm.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with our tech stack:
  • React 18, React Native, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, Vitest, React Testing Library, GitHub Actions, Yarn 4
  • Experience with real-time features (Socket.io, WebSockets) and streaming interfaces
  • Experience building and consuming shared component libraries or design systems
  • Familiarity with feature flag systems (GrowthBook or similar) and progressive rollout strategies
  • Background in B2C consumer products with high traffic and millions of daily active users
  • Experience with PWA architecture, service workers, and offline-first patterns
  • Familiarity with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence)
  • Interest or experience in AI/LLM products and conversational interfaces

Why join us?

  • Real 100% remote work (we don't have physical offices to go to "once per week")
  • Flex-time / Manage your schedule Policy (we are looking for teamwork and results, not hours)
  • Unlimited Vacations Policy
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • A dynamic and supportive work environment.

If you're passionate about AI and innovation and want to be at the forefront of the conversational AI revolution and join a team on the first few years of a great journey, apply today! We might have a seat for you on our rocketship!

title: Engenheiro(a) de Integração de Software Veicular
description:
SOBRE A VAGA:

ATIVIDADE: Implementação, integração e troubleshooting de software embarcado veicular , com atuação direta em caminhões e sistemas eletroeletrônicos automotivos.

RESUMO

O profissional selecionado atuará no time de Engenharia de Implementação de Software Veicular , em um ambiente industrial e altamente técnico, com foco na integração, validação e diagnóstico de software embarcado em caminhões .

A posição envolve atuação hands-on diretamente nos veículos , garantindo a correta implementação de software, análise de falhas, troubleshooting avançado e conformidade eletroeletrônica para liberação dos caminhões para rodagem.

O trabalho acontece em um contexto global e multifuncional , com interação constante com times de desenvolvimento de software, hardware e engenharia internacional, seguindo metodologia Agile / SCRUM .

FORMAÇÃO

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica, Automação ou áreas correlatas.

AMBIENTE DE TRABALHO

  • Engenharia de Produto / Implementação de Software
  • Atuação presencial em planta industrial
  • Projetos automotivos com interação global

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Realizar implementação e download de software embarcado em caminhões;
  • Atuar diretamente nos veículos realizando software breakdown, checks elétricos e eletrônicos e troubleshooting ;
  • Conduzir análises de causa raiz (root cause analysis) e resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Coletar, analisar e interpretar logs, DTCs, parâmetros e baselines de software;
  • Analisar diagramas elétricos automotivos e arquitetura eletroeletrônica dos veículos;
  • Trabalhar com diferentes arquiteturas e classes de caminhões;
  • Interface contínua com equipes de desenvolvimento de software e hardware, garantindo a conformidade do veículo;
  • Planejar e registrar atividades técnicas (relatórios, JIRA, documentação técnica);
  • Apoiar a preparação dos veículos para testes e liberação para rodagem em via pública.

REQUISITOS

  • Experiência prática com software embarcado automotivo ;
  • Vivência com implementação, integração ou validação de software veicular (não P&D);
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura elétrica e eletrônica automotiva (ECUs, redes veiculares);
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de diagramas elétricos automotivos ;
  • Conhecimento de protocolos automotivos: CAN, CAN FD, LIN e Ethernet ;
  • Experiência com troubleshooting e diagnóstico em veículos ou sistemas automotivos;
  • Perfil hands-on , analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas;
  • Conhecimento em metodologia Agile / SCRUM (JIRA como diferencial);
  • Pacote Office intermediário;
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação com times globais;
  • CNH C ou D (CNH E é diferencial).

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Experiência prévia em ambiente automotivo pesado (caminhões, ônibus, máquinas);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de diagnóstico e gestão de software automotivo, como:
  • CANalyzer (Vector);
  • EDB, SW Configurator;
  • Tech Tool / GDSP;
  • Vivência em ambientes industriais e projetos globais;
  • Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica em troubleshooting.

IDIOMAS

  • Inglês avançado – mandatório .

PERFIL

  • Profissional com forte atuação prática e presença em campo;
  • Capaz de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes nacionais e internacionais;
  • Confortável com ambiente industrial, pressão técnica e resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Boa comunicação, organização e autonomia para lidar com múltiplas demandas.

CARGO

Analista de Implementação de Software Veicular

CONTRATAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS

  • Contrato CLT;
  • Refeição no local;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Horário: 2ª a 6ª das 08:00 às 17:15 (100% presencial);

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint

Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.

About the Role

The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
Join one of the most exciting early-stage platforms as we scale our engineering team globally.

You’ll be building on your full-stack experience, evolving a platform that balances cutting-edge tech with real-world stability. We are looking for a pragmatic "builder" who is comfortable in a fast-moving, early-stage environment and can take a feature from a raw idea to a polished delivery.

Some of your day-to-day will be:

  • Independent Operator: Able to take ownership of tasks and work autonomously to hit delivery goals.
  • Communicator: Professional English proficiency (written and spoken) to collaborate with our international team.
  • Pragmatic: A focus on "what works" and "what scales," avoiding over-engineering where it isn’t needed.

Benefits:

  • International Contract (PJ): Competitive remuneration.
  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in Brazil.
  • Direct Impact: Work directly with the founding team; no layers of middle management.
  • Modern Stack: Access to the latest development tools and a clean, high-velocity environment.
  • Growth: Opportunity to grow alongside the platform as we scale.

Nice to have

title: Analista de Dados Pl (Proadi-SUS)
description:
O Hcor nasceu do trabalho da Associação Beneficente Síria, fundada por mulheres da comunidade árabe, com o objetivo de retribuir o acolhimento que receberam no Brasil. Assim, a diversidade e a inclusão estão em nossa essência e são valores que reconhecemos, valorizamos e queremos cada vez mais presentes em nossa instituição. Acreditamos no potencial da diversidade como instrumento de aprendizagem, crescimento e transformação, atrelados ao nosso propósito de cuidar das pessoas e fortalecer a saúde.

O hospital integra o Programa de Apoio ao Desenvolvimento Institucional do Sistema Único de Saúde (PROADI-SUS), iniciativa do Ministério da Saúde que promove parcerias com hospitais de excelência para apoiar o desenvolvimento e o fortalecimento do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS).

Em conformidade com a Portaria GM/MS nº 5.801/2024 e o nosso compromisso com a diversidade, equidade e inclusão, este processo seletivo está aberto para pessoas negras (pretas ou pardas), indígenas, quilombolas, pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e pessoas trans.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte da nossa instituição, será um prazer receber a sua candidatura.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Colaborar com gerentes de projeto e áreas para entender necessidades analíticas, definindo métricas, KPIs e gerando insights por meio da análise e visualização de dados para apoiar a tomada de decisão.
  • Desenvolver dashboards e relatórios de desempenho das áreas, especialmente em Responsabilidade Social, utilizando técnicas estatísticas para análise e interpretação de resultados.
  • Criar e manter visualizações interativas avançadas, integrando dados provenientes de diferentes fontes para análises mais completas.
  • Definir e monitorar o fluxo de documentações e a interação entre sistemas, garantindo organização e armazenamento adequado das informações.
  • Dar suporte às equipes, facilitando o acesso, a movimentação e o uso eficiente dos dados.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento, implementação, integração e manutenção de sistemas analíticos, contribuindo para a definição da lógica de aquisição e integração de dados.
  • Apoiar na definição e documentação de arquitetura e padrões de dados, conforme os projetos e produtos da área.
  • Contribuir para a escalabilidade, alta disponibilidade, tolerância a falhas e elasticidade dentro do ecossistema de dados.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação em áreas como Ciência de Dados, Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou correlatas.

Conhecimento em:

  • Inteligência Artificial (diferencial)
  • Data Warehouse

  • Ferramentas:
  • Power BI
  • Excel
  • Headcount (HeadCap)

title: Bolsista Doutor - Superbac - Otimização dos processos industriais e planta fabril | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Vem transformar com a gente!

Reconhecida por seu compromisso com a inovação e o desenvolvimento de produtos de base biológica, a empresa se destaca pelo uso de tecnologia de ponta e por contribuir ativamente com práticas sustentáveis no Brasil e no mundo.

ormação Acadêmica:

Graduação em Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Bioprocessos, Biotecnologia, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.

Doutorado em áreas compatíveis com atuação em desenvolvimento e otimização de processos biotecnológicos.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Otimização dos processos industriais e planta fabril para a produção de microrganismos e metabólitos, visando o aumento da produtividade e a redução de custos operacionais.

  • Coleta e análise de dados de produção de diferentes microrganismos;
  • Modelagem dos processos de cultivo;
  • Otimização de sistemas e definição de novas estratégias, parâmetros e variáveis de processo;
  • Atuação técnica com foco em produtividade e viabilidade econômica.

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Conhecimento em escalonamento de microrganismos e dimensionamento de biorreatores.
